sentences.zh: 兵四

translations.literal: Military 4
translations.idiomatic: Military 4

sentences.zh: 鄉兵

translations.literal: Local Militia
translations.idiomatic: Local Militia

sentences.zh: 鄉兵始自雍、乾，旋募旋散，初非經制之師。

translations.literal: Local militia began in the Yongzheng and Qianlong reigns; they were recruited and disbanded in turn and were at first not troops of the regular establishment.
translations.idiomatic: Village militia first appeared under the Yongzheng and Qianlong emperors, raised and released in cycles rather than as part of the standing army.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶間，平川、楚教匪，鄉兵之功始著。

translations.literal: During the Jiaqing period, in pacifying the Sichuan and Hubei sectarian rebels, the achievements of the local militia first became prominent.
translations.idiomatic: It was during the Jiaqing era, in the campaigns against the Sichuan and Hubei sectarian rebels, that local militia first won clear renown.

sentences.zh: 道光之季，粵西寇起，各省舉辦團練，有駐守地方者，有隨營征剿者。

translations.literal: At the end of the Daoguang reign, bandits rose in western Guangdong; every province organized militia training—some to garrison local areas, some to follow camps in campaigns of suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Daoguang reign, rebellion broke out in western Guangdong, and provinces across the empire set up tuanlian militia—some to hold their own districts, others to march with regular columns on punitive campaigns.

sentences.zh: 侍郎曾國籓以衡、湘團練討寇，練鄉兵為勇營，以兵制部勒之，卒平巨憝，其始皆鄉兵也。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Zeng Guofan used the militia of Hengzhou and Hunan to suppress the rebels, trained local militia into brave battalions, disciplined them by military regulations, and in the end pacified the great scourge—all of whom had begun as local militia.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Zeng Guofan mobilized the Heng and Xiang militia against the rebels, reshaped village troops into yongying brave battalions under regular military discipline, and finally crushed the main rebel force—every man of whom had started as a local militiaman.

sentences.zh: 而邊徼之地，剿有鄉兵。

translations.literal: In the frontier borderlands as well, there were local militia for suppression campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: On the frontiers, too, local militia took part in pacification.

sentences.zh: 其在東三省者，則寧古塔以東之赫哲部、克雅克部，混同江東北之鄂倫春部，不設佐領，惟設鄉兵姓長。

translations.literal: In the three eastern provinces, east of Ningguta were the Hezhe and Keyak tribes; northeast of the Sungari were the Oroqen—no assistant commandants were established, only clan chiefs of local militia by surname.
translations.idiomatic: In Manchuria, east of Ningguta lay the Hezhe and Keyak peoples, and northeast of the Sungari the Oroqen; these groups had no banner assistant commandants, only surname chiefs heading their village militia.

sentences.zh: 其在黑龍江者，有打牲人，在江以南之錫伯、卦勒察，江以北之索倫、達瑚爾，則附屬於滿營。

translations.literal: In Heilongjiang there were the hunting peoples; the Xibe and Geleqi south of the river, and the Solon and Dahur north of the river, were attached to Manchu camps.
translations.idiomatic: In Heilongjiang were the fur-hunting peoples; the Xibe and Geleqi south of the river and the Solon and Dahur north of it were attached to Manchu garrisons.

sentences.zh: 在蒙古者，蒙兵而外，有奇古民勇。

translations.literal: In Mongolia, besides Mongol troops, there were Qigu civilian braves.
translations.idiomatic: In Mongolia, beyond the regular Mongol forces, there were Qigu civilian braves.

sentences.zh: 在山、陝邊外者，有番兵，有僧俗兵。

translations.literal: Beyond the Shanxi and Shaanxi borders there were frontier tribesmen troops and monk-lay troops.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the Shanxi and Shaanxi frontier were frontier tribal levies and mixed monk and lay militia.

sentences.zh: 在四川、雲南、貴州邊境者，有夷兵，有土司兵，有黑裸勇丁。

translations.literal: On the borders of Sichuan, Yunnan, and Guizhou there were Yi troops, native-official troops, and Heiluo brave levies.
translations.idiomatic: Along the Sichuan, Yunnan, and Guizhou marches were Yi levies, tusi native-commander forces, and Heiluo brave companies.

sentences.zh: 在西藏者，有藏番兵。

translations.literal: In Tibet there were Tibetan frontier troops.
translations.idiomatic: In Tibet there were Tibetan border levies.

sentences.zh: 皆與內地鄉兵不同，故不詳。

translations.literal: All differed from the local militia of the interior provinces, and therefore are not described in detail.
translations.idiomatic: These all differed from interior local militia and are therefore not treated here in detail.

sentences.zh: 其各直省之鄉兵，曰屯練，曰民壯，曰鄉團，曰獵戶，曰漁團，曰沙民。

translations.literal: The local militia of the various provinces were called garrison militia, civil braves, village corps, hunter companies, fishing corps, and sand-dweller levies.
translations.idiomatic: In the provinces proper, local militia went under many names—garrison militia, civil braves, village corps, hunter bands, fishing militia, and sand-flat levies.

sentences.zh: 額數之多寡不齊，器械之良窳不一，餉章之增減不定，良以聚散無恆，故與額兵迥異，無編製之可紀。

translations.literal: Their authorized numbers varied greatly, their weapons in quality were not uniform, and their pay scales rose and fell without fixity—truly because assembly and dispersal had no constancy; hence they differed utterly from quota troops and had no establishment that could be recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Headcounts varied widely, arms ranged from excellent to poor, and pay tables shifted without pattern, for these forces gathered and dissolved at will; they bore no resemblance to regular quota troops and admit of no fixed table of organization.

sentences.zh: 茲特志其始末於後焉。

translations.literal: Here the beginning and end are specially recorded below.
translations.idiomatic: What follows is a chronological account of how this system arose and evolved.

sentences.zh: 雍正八年，鄂爾泰平西南夷烏蒙之亂，調官兵萬餘人，鄉兵半之，遂定東川，是為鄉兵之始。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Yongzheng, Ortai pacified the rebellion of the southwestern Yi at Wumeng; more than ten thousand government troops were mobilized, local militia equaling half that number, and thus Dongchuan was secured—this was the beginning of local militia.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 8 (1730), Ortai put down the Wumeng uprising among the southwestern Yi, bringing more than ten thousand regulars and an equal number of local militia into the field; Dongchuan was pacified, and this marks the origin of the village militia system.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十八年，用兵小金川，定邊將軍溫福、定西將軍阿桂疏言，調滿洲兵道遠費重，不如多用鄉兵，人地相宜。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year of Qianlong, when troops were used at Lesser Jinchuan, the Pacification Commissioner Wen Fu and the Western Pacification Commissioner Agui memorialized that mobilizing Manchu troops over long distances was costly and that it was better to use more local militia, as men and terrain suited each other.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 38 (1773), during the Lesser Jinchuan campaign, Generals Wen Fu and Agui argued in memorials that hauling Manchu bannermen across vast distances was ruinously expensive and that local militia, matched to people and terrain, served far better.

sentences.zh: 四川鄉兵，以金川屯練為強，自平定金川以後，設屯練鄉兵，其糧餉倍於額兵，分屯大小金川兩路，春夏訓練，秋冬蒐獵，有戰事則搜剿山路，退兵則為殿後之用。

translations.literal: Sichuan local militia were strongest in the Jinchuan garrison militia; after the pacification of Jinchuan, garrison militia were established, their rations double those of quota troops, garrisoned along the two routes of Greater and Lesser Jinchuan; in spring and summer they trained, in autumn and winter they hunted; when there was fighting they searched and suppressed mountain paths, and when troops withdrew they served as rearguard.
translations.idiomatic: Among Sichuan village troops, the Jinchuan garrison militia were the hard core. After the Jinchuan wars, garrison militia were posted on both the Greater and Lesser Jinchuan routes at double regular pay; they drilled in spring and summer, hunted in autumn and winter, scoured mountain trails when fighting broke out, and covered the army's retreat when columns withdrew.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初，苗疆事起，傅鼐以鄉兵平苗，功冠諸將。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jiaqing, trouble arose in the Miao frontier; Fu Nai pacified the Miao with local militia, his achievements surpassing all generals.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jiaqing, rebellion flared across the Miao frontier; Fu Nai crushed it with local militia and outshone every field commander.

sentences.zh: 詔以鼐總理邊務，令各省督撫以鼐練鄉兵之法練官兵。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Fu Nai to oversee frontier affairs and ordered governors-general and governors of every province to train government troops by Fu Nai's method of training local militia.
translations.idiomatic: The throne put Fu Nai in charge of frontier affairs and instructed every provincial governor to drill regular troops using his militia-training methods.

sentences.zh: 川、楚教匪之役，官兵征討，而鄉兵之功為多。

translations.literal: In the Sichuan and Hubei sectarian-rebel campaigns, government troops carried out the expeditions, yet the achievements of the local militia were the greater.
translations.idiomatic: In the Sichuan and Hubei sectarian wars, regulars bore the official campaigns, but local militia won the greater share of credit.

sentences.zh: 其勛績最著者，文臣則四川按察使劉清，武臣則四川提督桂涵，湖北提督羅思舉，各統鄉兵，分路剿寇，大小數百戰，遂奏膚功。

translations.literal: Those whose merit was most outstanding were, among civil officials, Sichuan Provincial Surveillance Commissioner Liu Qing, and among military officials, Sichuan Provincial Military Commissioner Gui Han and Hubei Provincial Military Commissioner Luo Siju; each commanded local militia, suppressed rebels by separate routes, fought several hundred engagements large and small, and thus achieved complete victory.
translations.idiomatic: The standouts were the civil official Liu Qing, Sichuan surveillance commissioner, and the generals Gui Han of Sichuan and Luo Siju of Hubei; each led village militia along separate routes through hundreds of clashes large and small until the rebels were annihilated.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十七年，以雲南邊外野夷裸匪肆擾，而緬寧、騰越各隘皆瘴癘之地，難駐官兵，乃練鄉兵一千六百人，以八百人駐守緬寧之丙野山樑等處，以八百人駐守騰越蠻章山等處，省官兵徵調之勞。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Jiaqing, because wild Yi and Heiluo bandits on the Yunnan frontier ran riot, and the passes at Mianning and Tengyue were all malarial places where it was hard to station government troops, sixteen hundred local militia were trained—eight hundred to garrison Bingye Shanliang and other places in Mianning, eight hundred to garrison Manzhang Shan and other places in Tengyue—sparing the labor of mobilizing government troops.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 17 (1812), wild tribesmen and Heiluo raiders harried Yunnan's borders; the Mianning and Tengyue passes were too malarial for regular garrisons, so sixteen hundred local militia were raised—eight hundred for Bingye Shanliang and neighboring posts in Mianning, eight hundred for Manzhang Shan and the Tengyue sector—relieving the army of constant redeployments.

sentences.zh: 其時苗疆底定，亦增設鄉兵，凡屯丁七千人，訓練之暇，開墾屯防田數十萬頃。

translations.literal: At that time, with the Miao frontier settled, local militia were also increased; in all seven thousand garrison settlers, in intervals between training, opened and reclaimed several hundred thousand mu of garrison-defense fields.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Miao frontier had quieted, militia were expanded further: seven thousand garrison settlers, between drills, reclaimed hundreds of thousands of mu of frontier farmland.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，令直隸疆臣招集團練，修築土堡，互為策應。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang, frontier officials of Zhili were ordered to recruit militia training, build earthen forts, and support one another in concert.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 2 (1822), Zhili frontier officials were told to raise tuanlian militia, build earthen forts, and coordinate mutual defense.

sentences.zh: 十五年，令各州縣額設民壯，一律充補訓練，復令各省民壯每月隨營操演，范以紀律。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, every prefecture and county was ordered to fill its authorized quota of civil braves and train them uniformly; it was further ordered that civil braves in every province drill monthly with camps and be molded by discipline.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year (1835), counties were to fill their civil-brave quotas and put them through uniform training; provinces were also to drill these men monthly alongside regular camps under strict discipline.

sentences.zh: 是年，調大小金川鄉兵千名，給以千人之糧，隨營征戰，歸屯則仍食五百人之糧。

translations.literal: That year, one thousand local militia of Greater and Lesser Jinchuan were mobilized, paid rations for one thousand men when following camps in campaigns, and when returning to garrison still received rations for five hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: That same year, a thousand Jinchuan militia were called up at full thousand-man rations while on campaign; on return to garrison their pay reverted to a five-hundred-man scale.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，令山東巡撫於蓬萊、黃縣、榮成、寧海、掖縣、膠州、即墨所屬之十三梟，編練鄉兵，互相防衛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, the Shandong governor was ordered to organize and train local militia in the thirteen coastal districts subordinate to Penglai, Huangxian, Rongcheng, Ninghai, Yexian, Jiaozhou, and Jimo, for mutual defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year (1841), the Shandong governor was to drill village militia across thirteen coastal subdistricts under Penglai, Huang, Rongcheng, Ninghai, Ye, Jiaozhou, and Jimo for mutual coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 又令沿海疆臣仿浙江定海縣土堡之法，凡近海村落，招募鄉兵，興築土堡，以聯聲勢。

translations.literal: Coastal frontier officials were further ordered to follow the method of earthen forts in Dinghai County, Zhejiang: in every village near the sea, recruit local militia and build earthen forts to link their strength.
translations.idiomatic: Coastal governors were also told to copy Dinghai County's earthen-fort model in Zhejiang—recruiting militia and building forts in seaside hamlets to knit local defenses together.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，令廣東省以團練助防海口。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Guangdong Province was ordered to use militia training to assist in defending the estuary.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year (1843), Guangdong was ordered to use tuanlian militia to help guard the Pearl River estuary.

sentences.zh: 旋疆吏疏言廣東民風宜於鄉團，招集已得十萬人，以昇平學社為團練總匯之區，推及韶州、廉州等處，一律舉行。

translations.literal: Soon a frontier official memorialized that Guangdong popular custom suited village corps; one hundred thousand men had already been recruited, with the Shengping Academy society as the general rallying area for militia training, extended to Shaozhou, Lianzhou, and other places, all carried out uniformly.
translations.idiomatic: A provincial memorial soon reported that Guangdong's local culture lent itself to village corps: a hundred thousand men were already enrolled, centered on the Shengping Academy society as the militia hub, with the same program spreading to Shaozhou, Lianzhou, and beyond.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，令各州縣民壯隨營考察技藝。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, civil braves of every prefecture and county were ordered to follow camps for examination of their skills.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year (1846), every county's civil braves were to drill with regular camps so their skills could be inspected.

sentences.zh: 是年，甘肅沿邊番賊肆擾，令疆臣召募獵戶千人，編為一軍，供遠探近防之用。

translations.literal: That year, frontier tribesmen bandits along the Gansu border ran riot; frontier officials were ordered to recruit one thousand hunter households, organized as one army, for distant reconnaissance and near defense.
translations.idiomatic: That year, tribal raiders along the Gansu frontier grew bold; officials there recruited a thousand hunter households into a single corps for long-range scouting and local defense.

sentences.zh: 及道光季年，張國樑募廣東潮州鄉兵追逐粵寇，轉戰東下，卒以獷悍不馴，遂至潰散。

translations.literal: By the last years of Daoguang, Zhang Guoliang recruited Chaozhou local militia of Guangdong to pursue the Guangdong rebels, fighting eastward in turn, but in the end because they were fierce and unruly they collapsed and scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Late in Daoguang, Zhang Guoliang raised Chaozhou militia to chase the Cantonese rebels eastward; their ferocity and indiscipline eventually brought rout and dispersal.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，令在籍侍郎曾國籓辦理湖南鄉團。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng, the retired Vice Minister Zeng Guofan was ordered to manage Hunan village corps.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 2 (1852), the retired vice minister Zeng Guofan was put in charge of Hunan's village militia.

sentences.zh: 旋國籓疏言先行練勇一千人，所辦者乃官勇非團丁，是為鄉團改勇營之始。

translations.literal: Soon Zeng Guofan memorialized that he would first train one thousand braves; what he organized were government braves, not militia youths—this was the beginning of village corps being converted into brave battalions.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng soon reported that he would begin by drilling a thousand men—but these were government braves, not village militia youths, marking the first step from tuanlian corps to formal yongying battalions.

sentences.zh: 三年，令山東登、萊、青三府舉辦聯庄團練，給以兵械。

translations.literal: In the third year, the three prefectures of Deng, Lai, and Qing in Shandong were ordered to undertake linked-village militia training and were supplied with weapons.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (1853), Shandong's Deng, Lai, and Qing prefectures were to organize linked-village tuanlian and were issued arms.

sentences.zh: 四年，令甘肅沿邊增募獵戶三千人以防番騎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, along the Gansu border an additional three thousand hunter households were recruited to guard against tribal cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (1854), Gansu's frontier added three thousand hunter levies against tribal horsemen.

sentences.zh: 八年，安徽巡撫翁同書疏言皖省定遠、壽州、合肥等縣舉辦團練，旬日之間，遠近響應，和州踞賊屢出焚掠，多被鄉團擊回，以其深明大義，踴躍同仇，凡董事團總人等，傳諭嘉勉。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Anhui Governor Weng Tongshu memorialized that in Dingyuan, Shouzhou, Hefei, and other counties of Anhui Province militia training had been undertaken; within ten days near and far responded; rebels holding Hezhou repeatedly came out to burn and plunder and were mostly beaten back by village corps; because they deeply understood the great cause and eagerly shared the enmity, all directors, corps chiefs, and the like were commended by transmitted order.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (1858), Anhui governor Weng Tongshu reported tuanlian underway in Dingyuan, Shou, Hefei, and other counties, with the whole province rallying within ten days; rebels holding Hezhou were repeatedly driven back when they raided, and the directors and corps chiefs who had shown such public spirit received imperial commendation.

sentences.zh: 九年，河南巡撫恆福疏言，皖寇進偪豫境，令道府大員於接近皖寇之地，舉辦鄉團，睢州等州縣興築堡寨已數十處。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Henan Governor Heng Fu memorialized that Anhui rebels were pressing close to the Henan border; circuit and prefectural officials were ordered to undertake village corps in places near the Anhui rebels; in Suizhou and other prefectures and counties several dozen fortresses and stockades had already been built.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year (1859), Henan governor Heng Fu warned that Anhui rebels were nearing the border and ordered circuit and prefectural officers to raise village corps along the threatened line; Suizhou and neighboring counties had already thrown up dozens of stockaded forts.

sentences.zh: 旋諭河南官紳訓練鄉勇，聯村築寨，迅速舉行。

translations.literal: Soon an edict ordered Henan officials and gentry to train village braves, link villages in building stockades, and carry this out swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: An edict soon followed instructing Henan's officials and gentry to drill village braves, link hamlets into fortified clusters, and act without delay.

sentences.zh: 十年，諭勝保等督辦鄉團，以資統率，酌定章程，凡辦團州縣一律遵行，惟鄉團更番調營，所領糧餉，易滋流弊，毋得冒濫。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Sheng Bao and others were instructed to supervise village corps for unified command, regulations were drawn up for all counties organizing corps to follow uniformly; only when village corps rotated in turns to camps, the rations they received easily bred abuses—there must be no false claims or excess.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year (1860), Sheng Bao and others were told to supervise village corps province-wide under uniform regulations, with a warning that rotating militia through regular camps invited pay fraud and must not be abused.

sentences.zh: 又諭：「江蘇等省在籍紳士，除已經辦理團練外，其明曉大義律身公正者，自不乏人，所有在京直隸、江蘇、安徽、浙江、河南等省之大小官員，將如何舉行鄉團，隨同官兵剿賊，及防守等一切事宜，各陳所見，各舉所知，迅即上聞。

translations.literal: It was further ordered: "Among retired gentry of Jiangsu and other provinces, besides those who have already organized militia training, those who understand the great cause and conduct themselves with integrity are certainly not lacking. All officials large and small from Zhili, Jiangsu, Anhui, Zhejiang, Henan, and other provinces now in the capital shall set forth their views on how to undertake village corps, join government troops in suppressing rebels, and all matters of defense, each recommend those they know, and report swiftly."
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ran: "Beyond gentry already running tuanlian in Jiangsu and elsewhere, many retired men of principle remain available. Every official from Zhili, Jiangsu, Anhui, Zhejiang, Henan, and the other affected provinces now in Beijing must submit plans for village corps, joint operations with regulars, and local defense, recommend capable men, and report at once."

sentences.zh: 尋侍郎沈兆霖疏陳：「自咸豐三年以後，迭奉朝旨舉行鄉團，已至再至三，各省官紳士民，未嘗不遵旨辦理，而賊勢披猖，卒無成效。

translations.literal: Soon Vice Minister Shen Zhaolin memorialized: "Since the third year of Xianfeng, court edicts to undertake village corps have been repeated again and again; officials, gentry, scholars, and commoners in every province have not failed to comply, yet the rebels' power has run rampant and in the end there has been no effect."
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Shen Zhaolin soon wrote: "Since Xianfeng 3 the court has ordered village corps again and again; every province's officials, gentry, and people have obeyed, yet the rebels still rage and the policy has failed."

sentences.zh: 良由苟且塗飾，未經實力講求，或募勇以充數，徒取外觀，或藉端以營私，轉成欲壑，無事則恃為威脅，擾害鄉閭，有警則首先遁逃，流為盜賊。

translations.literal: Truly because of perfunctory whitewashing without earnest pursuit in substance—some recruited braves merely to fill numbers and took only outward appearance, some used pretexts for private profit and turned into insatiable gulfs; when there was no trouble they relied on this to threaten and harass the countryside, and when there was alarm they were the first to flee and became bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The fault lies in cosmetic compliance: some hired mercenaries merely to pad rolls; others turned the corps into extortion rackets—bullying neighbors in peacetime, running first when fighting started, and finally becoming bandits themselves.

sentences.zh: 議者幾謂鄉團之無益而有損矣。

translations.literal: Discussants nearly said that village corps were useless and even harmful.
translations.idiomatic: Critics were ready to declare village corps worse than useless.

sentences.zh: 不知名為民團，即當以民為團，而不可以募勇塞責也。

translations.literal: They did not know that what is called a people's corps must take the people as the corps, and cannot use recruited braves to fulfill responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: They forgot that a people's corps must be drawn from the people themselves, not filled out with hired mercenaries.

sentences.zh: 民統於紳，則紳之邪正宜慎擇也。

translations.literal: When the people are led by gentry, then the uprightness or depravity of the gentry must be carefully chosen.
translations.idiomatic: Because commoners follow local gentry, only upright leaders should be chosen.

sentences.zh: 紳倚於官，則官之賢否宜嚴辨也。

translations.literal: When gentry rely on officials, then the worth or unworthiness of officials must be strictly distinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Because gentry depend on magistrates, only capable and honest officials will do.

sentences.zh: 不歸併於一路，則督察無人，必不能一律堅固。

translations.literal: If not consolidated under one route of command, then there is no one to supervise and inspect, and uniformity and solidity cannot be achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Without a single chain of command, no one can supervise the corps and they will never stand firm as one.

sentences.zh: 不專力於四鄉，則城守雖嚴，已難免四面受敵。

translations.literal: If effort is not concentrated on the four countryside districts, then though city defense is strict, one can hardly avoid being attacked on all four sides.
translations.idiomatic: Unless the countryside is fortified as well, even the stoutest walled city will be besieged from every quarter.

sentences.zh: 官與紳宜兩相孚，不宜兩相阨。

translations.literal: Officials and gentry should trust each other mutually, and should not obstruct each other mutually.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates and gentry must work in mutual trust, not mutual obstruction.

sentences.zh: 兵與民宜兩相顧，不宜兩相仇。

translations.literal: Soldiers and people should look after each other mutually, and should not hate each other mutually.
translations.idiomatic: Troops and civilians must protect one another, not treat each other as enemies.

sentences.zh: 任封疆者，當知民本吾民，用兵數少，何如用民數多。

translations.literal: Those charged with frontier territories should know that the people are fundamentally our people; using few soldiers—how does that compare with using many people?
translations.idiomatic: Frontier governors must remember that the people are their own people: a handful of soldiers cannot match the strength of mobilizing the many.

sentences.zh: 任將帥者，當知兵本吾民，我能救民，自然民能救我。

translations.literal: Those charged as generals should know that soldiers are fundamentally our people; if I can save the people, naturally the people can save me.
translations.idiomatic: Field commanders must know their soldiers are drawn from the same people: save the populace and the populace will save you.

sentences.zh: 現在賊氛猖獗，非實辦民團，更無安全之法。

translations.literal: Now rebel atmosphere is rampant; unless people's corps are truly organized, there is no other method of safety.
translations.idiomatic: With rebellion raging today, only a genuine people's militia can bring safety.

sentences.zh: 」乃擬上事宜十二條：「一、民團須招本地有業之民，不可招市井無賴也。

translations.literal: " He then drafted twelve matters for presentation: "First, people's corps must recruit local people with established livelihoods; one must not recruit marketplace riffraff."
translations.idiomatic: " He proposed twelve measures: "First, recruit only local men with honest livelihoods—never street loafers."

sentences.zh: 一、宜分別地段，以近賊一、二百里為最要，距賊稍遠，中隔一、二縣者為次要，其遠在三、四百里外者，則從緩辦團也。

translations.literal: Second, districts should be distinguished: within one or two hundred li of the rebels is most critical; somewhat farther, with one or two counties in between, is secondary; those three or four hundred li away may organize corps more slowly.
translations.idiomatic: Second, prioritize by distance: the belt within one or two hundred li of rebel territory is urgent; counties one or two removes away are secondary; places three or four hundred li off may proceed more slowly.

sentences.zh: 一、各州縣要地，宜一律辦團，無使一處疏漏，俾寇得乘隙而入也。

translations.literal: Third, in critical places of every prefecture and county corps should be organized uniformly, with no place left open so that bandits may enter through a gap.
translations.idiomatic: Third, every strategic point in each county must be covered so rebels cannot slip through a gap.

sentences.zh: 一、辦團宜四鄉加密，有警則互相應援，無事則嚴詰姦宄，庶城守完固也。

translations.literal: Fourth, in organizing corps the four countryside districts should be thickened; when there is alarm they should aid one another, when there is no trouble they should strictly examine traitors and spies—then city defense may be made complete and solid.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, thicken defenses across all four rural districts: mutual aid when alarm sounds, strict watch for spies in quiet times, so the walled city stands secure.

sentences.zh: 一、牧令宜擇賢能，與辦團之紳，不得各存意見，亦不得任用劣紳也。

translations.literal: Fifth, magistrates should be chosen for ability; with gentry who organize corps they must not each hold separate opinions, nor may inferior gentry be employed.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, appoint capable magistrates who work in concert with corps-leading gentry—never petty factions, never corrupt local bosses.

sentences.zh: 一、宜簡道府大員分路辦團，俾各縣聯為一氣也。

translations.literal: Sixth, circuit and prefectural officials of rank should be selected to organize corps by separate routes, so that all counties may be linked as one breath.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, assign senior circuit and prefectural officers to coordinate corps by sector so counties act as one body.

sentences.zh: 一、民團有急，官兵速往救援，不得觀望也。

translations.literal: Seventh, when people's corps are in urgent need, government troops must go swiftly to rescue them and must not stand by and watch.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh, when militia are hard pressed, regulars must march to their relief without delay.

sentences.zh: 一、宜擇要設卡盤查也。

translations.literal: Eighth, key points should be chosen to set up checkpoints for inspection.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth, establish checkpoints at strategic points for search and inspection.

sentences.zh: 一、民團祗可就地助戰，不宜調遣，變為練勇，失其恆業也。

translations.literal: Ninth, people's corps may only assist in fighting on the spot; they should not be transferred and turned into trained braves, losing their regular occupations.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth, militia should fight only on home ground—not be redeployed as mercenary braves and stripped of their livelihoods.

sentences.zh: 一、立功宜即獎勵，視官兵稍優也。

translations.literal: Tenth, merit should be rewarded immediately, slightly better than for government troops.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth, reward valor on the spot, with terms slightly better than for regular soldiers.

sentences.zh: 一、團費宜自捐自辦，不得藉端漁利也。

translations.literal: Eleventh, corps expenses should be self-donated and self-managed; one must not use pretexts to fish for profit.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh, corps funds must be raised and spent locally—no pretext for profiteering.

sentences.zh: 一、民團辦成，則分防之兵可省，集合成軍，攻剿更為得力也。

translations.literal: Twelfth, when people's corps are successfully organized, troops for dispersed defense may be saved; gathered into an army, attack and suppression will be more effective.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth, once militia are in place, garrison troops may be reduced and concentrated for more effective offensive campaigns.

sentences.zh: 同時應詔陳言者，有載垣等所議團練章程十條，賈楨等所擬辦理章程八條。

translations.literal: At the same time those who responded to the edict with memorials included the ten articles on militia training regulations discussed by Zaiyuan and others, and the eight articles on handling regulations drafted by Jia Zhen and others.
translations.idiomatic: Others answering the edict included Zaiyuan's ten-article tuanlian regulations and Jia Zhen's eight-article implementation plan.

sentences.zh: 旋命順天府府丞毛昶熙為督辦河南團練大臣，南汝光道鄭元善幫辦團練事宜，按照怡親王載垣等所擬章程辦理。

translations.literal: Soon Assistant Prefect of Shuntian Fu Mao Changxi was appointed Grand Minister for Supervising Henan Militia Training, and Nanyuguang Circuit Intendant Zheng Yuanshan was assigned to assist militia affairs, handled according to the regulations drafted by Prince Yi Zaiyuan and others.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Changxi, assistant prefect of Shuntian, was named grand supervisor of Henan tuanlian, with circuit intendant Zheng Yuanshan as his deputy, operating under Prince Yi's regulations.

sentences.zh: 命戶部右侍郎杜為督辦山東團練大臣，登萊青道貢璜、登州府知府盧朝安幫辦團練事宜，按照大學士賈楨等所擬條款，並參酌河南章程，體察情形辦理。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Revenue Du Wei was appointed Grand Minister for Supervising Shandong Militia Training; Denglaqing Circuit Commissioner Gong Huang and Dengzhou Prefect Lu Chao'an were assigned to assist militia affairs, handled according to the clauses drafted by Grand Secretary Jia Zhen and others, also consulting the Henan regulations and adapting to local conditions.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Revenue Du Wei supervised Shandong tuanlian, assisted by circuit commissioner Gong Huang and Dengzhou prefect Lu Chao'an, following Jia Zhen's articles while adapting Henan's model to local conditions.

sentences.zh: 又以皖南地方緊要，應一律辦團，令兩江總督曾國籓察看情形，擇其諳練軍務素有人望者，酌保一人，即令督辦皖南團練事宜。

translations.literal: Because southern Anhui was a critical region and corps should be organized uniformly throughout, Governor-General of Liangjiang Zeng Guofan was ordered to examine conditions, select one versed in military affairs and of longstanding public esteem, recommend him as appropriate, and immediately appoint him to supervise southern Anhui militia affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Anhui being critical, Zeng Guofan was told to survey conditions, nominate one man of military experience and public standing, and put him in charge of tuanlian there.

sentences.zh: 旋曾國籓覆陳：「鄉團本是良法，然奉行不善，縣官徒藉以斂費，局紳亦從而分肥，賊至則先行潰逃，賊退則重加苛派，轉為地方之弊。

translations.literal: Soon Zeng Guofan replied: "Village corps were originally a good method, yet when poorly carried out, county magistrates merely used them to collect fees, bureau gentry also followed to divide the fat; when bandits came they fled first in collapse, when bandits retreated they imposed heavy exactions anew—turning into a local abuse."
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan replied bluntly: "Village corps are sound in principle, but in practice magistrates use them only to levy money, gentry skim the proceeds, men flee before the enemy arrives, and after the enemy leaves the people are taxed again—it has become a local scourge."

sentences.zh: 所經過各省，從未見有鄉團能專打一股、專克一城者，不過隨官兵之後，勝則貪財，敗則先奔，常藉口於工食之太少。

translations.literal: In every province he passed through, he had never seen village corps able to strike one band alone or capture one city alone; they merely followed government troops—when victorious they were greedy for loot, when defeated they ran first, often using as pretext that their rations and pay were too little.
translations.idiomatic: In every province he had marched through, no village corps had ever destroyed a rebel band or taken a city on their own; they merely trailed the regulars—plundering after victories, running first in defeat, always complaining that pay was too low.

sentences.zh: 而辦理歧異者，每多給錢文，團丁所領之餉，與官勇例價相同，且有過之。

translations.literal: Yet those who handled matters differently often gave more cash; the pay received by militia youths equaled the standard price for government braves and sometimes exceeded it.
translations.idiomatic: Where organizers deviated from the rules, they often paid even more: militia youths sometimes drew the same rations as government braves—or more.

sentences.zh: 其取之民間，無非勸捐抽釐之類。

translations.literal: What they took from the people was nothing but voluntary contributions, transit levies, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: All of this was wrung from the people through donation drives and transit levies.

sentences.zh: 是於團練已失其本義，于軍餉又大有妨礙。

translations.literal: Thus militia training had already lost its original meaning, and military pay was also greatly harmed.
translations.idiomatic: Tuanlian had lost its original purpose and was draining the regular war chest as well.

sentences.zh: 今奉諭舉行皖南團練，皖南嶺隘紛歧，若築碉設卡，有險可憑，徽、寧各要隘，宜擇地築碉，以資防守。

translations.literal: Now obeying the order to undertake southern Anhui militia training—southern Anhui's mountain passes are numerous and branching; if blockhouses are built and checkpoints set, there are defiles to rely on—the critical passes of Huizhou and Ningguo should have sites chosen to build blockhouses for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered now to organize southern Anhui tuanlian, I note that its mountain passes are numerous; blockhouses and checkpoints at defensible points—especially the Huizhou and Ningguo corridors—would anchor local defense.

sentences.zh: 有在籍翰林院編修宋夢蘭當賊由太平縣竄擾徽州，宋夢蘭督帶練丁協力嚴守，眾論翕然。

translations.literal: There is the retired Hanlin Academy Compiler Song Menglan: when bandits from Taiping County raided into Huizhou, Song Menglan supervised and led trained levies in joint effort to defend strictly, and public opinion was unanimous.
translations.idiomatic: Retired Hanlin compiler Song Menglan, when rebels from Taiping raided Huizhou, led trained levies in a stout defense that won universal praise.

sentences.zh: 請即以該員辦理皖南團練事宜，會同委員，董勸各屬紳民，興築碉塞。

translations.literal: I request that this official be appointed to handle southern Anhui militia affairs, together with commissioners to urge gentry and people of every subordinate district and raise blockhouses and barriers.
translations.idiomatic: I recommend appointing him to southern Anhui tuanlian, working with commissioners to rally local gentry and build blockhouses.

sentences.zh: 其未經克復者，官兵攻剿，概不令團丁隨往。

translations.literal: In places not yet recovered, government troops shall attack and suppress; militia youths are generally not to be sent along.
translations.idiomatic: In unreclaimed territory, regulars alone should conduct offensives—militia must not follow them.

sentences.zh: 其已經克復者，紳耆修碉，團丁守之。

translations.literal: In places already recovered, elder gentry shall repair blockhouses and militia youths shall guard them.
translations.idiomatic: In recovered districts, gentry should build the forts and militia should garrison them.

sentences.zh: 庶幾軍民兩利，名實相符矣。

translations.literal: Then perhaps both army and people will benefit, and name and reality will correspond.
translations.idiomatic: Thus army and people may both gain, and the system may live up to its name.

sentences.zh: 又以四川地屬岩疆，毗連雲、貴，滇匪滋擾，未能肅清。

translations.literal: It was further noted that Sichuan's territory belongs to rugged frontier lands, bordering Yunnan and Guizhou; Yunnan bandits grew increasingly troublesome and could not be pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan was also noted as a rugged frontier adjoining Yunnan and Guizhou, where Yunnan rebels still harassed the borders without full pacification.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶間，四川舉辦鄉團，行堅壁清野之法，著有成效，自應仿辦。

translations.literal: During Jiaqing, Sichuan undertook village corps and practiced the method of strengthening walls and clearing the countryside, with marked results; this should naturally be imitated.
translations.idiomatic: Under Jiaqing, Sichuan's village corps and fortified-clear-country strategy had proved effective and should be revived.

sentences.zh: 所有應行事宜，諭四川在京各員，就地方情形，各抒所見。

translations.literal: Regarding all matters that should be carried out, Sichuan officials in the capital were instructed, according to local conditions, each to set forth his views.
translations.idiomatic: All Sichuan officials then in Beijing were told to submit recommendations suited to local conditions.

sentences.zh: 官紳中有練達時務者，各舉所知，以俟後命。

translations.literal: Among officials and gentry versed in current affairs, each was to recommend those he knew, awaiting further orders.
translations.idiomatic: Capable officials and gentry were to recommend qualified men and await further orders.

sentences.zh: 同時尚書陳孚恩等以江西毗連安徽、浙江、廣東等省，疏請辦理團練，酌保辦事人員，並擬團練事宜八條。

translations.literal: At the same time Minister Chen Fu'en and others, because Jiangxi bordered Anhui, Zhejiang, Guangdong, and other provinces, memorialized requesting militia training, recommending appropriate handling personnel, and drafting eight articles on militia affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Chen Fu'en meanwhile noted that Jiangxi adjoined Anhui, Zhejiang, and Guangdong, requested tuanlian, nominated officers to run it, and drafted eight implementation articles.

sentences.zh: 疏入，允行。

translations.literal: The memorial entered; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 命在籍翰林院修撰劉繹為江西督辦團練大臣，吉南贛寧道沈葆楨、甘肅安肅道劉於潯幫辦團練事宜，按照陳孚恩等所擬章程，妥為辦理。

translations.literal: The retired Hanlin Academy Compiler Liu Yi was appointed Grand Minister for Supervising Jiangxi Militia Training; Jinan'ganing Circuit Intendant Shen Baozhen and Gansu Ansu Circuit Intendant Liu Yuqun were assigned to assist militia affairs, handled properly according to the regulations drafted by Chen Fu'en and others.
translations.idiomatic: Retired Hanlin compiler Liu Yi was named Jiangxi's tuanlian supervisor, with Shen Baozhen and Liu Yuqun as deputies, implementing Chen Fu'en's regulations.

sentences.zh: 同時督辦河南團練大臣、順天府府丞毛昶熙疏陳團練辦法，並酌擬規條：一、添築堡寨以扼要隘，一、講求險要以便堵御，一、慎擇首事以資統率，一、分選團丁以備訓練，一、攤派練費以備公用，一、互為聲援以資聯絡，一、申明號令以壹眾志，一、嚴定約束以禁頑暴，一、秉公賞罰以示勸懲，一、嚴察姦宄以防內應，一、旌表忠義以作民氣，一、事貴實力以冀成功。

translations.literal: At the same time the Grand Minister for Supervising Henan Militia Training, Assistant Prefect of Shuntian Fu Mao Changxi, memorialized on militia methods and drafted regulations: first, add and build fortresses and stockades to hold critical passes; second, study defiles for convenient blocking defense; third, carefully choose leaders for unified command; fourth, select corps members separately for training; fifth, apportion drill expenses for public use; sixth, mutual vocal support for linkage; seventh, clarify orders and signals to unify the people's will; eighth, strictly fix constraints to forbid violent unruliness; ninth, reward and punish impartially to show encouragement and warning; tenth, strictly investigate traitors and spies to guard against internal collusion; eleventh, commend loyalty and righteousness to rouse the people's spirit; twelfth, affairs value real effort to hope for success.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Changxi, Henan's tuanlian supervisor, also submitted methods and twelve rules: build stockades at key passes; study terrain for defense; choose reliable leaders; select and train corps members; apportion drill funds fairly; coordinate mutual support; unify command signals; enforce discipline; reward and punish impartially; watch for spies; honor loyal service; and above all rely on earnest effort.

sentences.zh: 疏入，允行。

translations.literal: The memorial entered; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: This too was approved.

sentences.zh: 毛昶熙又疏陳河南團練，以歸、陳二府為先。

translations.literal: Mao Changxi again memorialized on Henan militia training, taking the two prefectures of Gui and Chen first.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Changxi added that Henan tuanlian should begin with the Gui and Chen prefectures.

sentences.zh: 前統兵大臣勝保，因調團不齊，勒派百姓出資雇丁，統計勇糧運費，較正供多至倍蓰，百姓苦累，紛紛稟請，以抽丁一項，民力已竭，鄉團勢難再辦。

translations.literal: Former Commander-in-Chief Sheng Bao, because the mobilized corps were not complete, compelled the people to contribute funds to hire men; counting brave rations and transport costs, they exceeded regular tax payments by as much as several times; the people suffered bitterly and petitioned in numbers, saying that with conscription of levies alone the people's strength was already exhausted and village corps could hardly be undertaken again.
translations.idiomatic: Former commander Sheng Bao, finding his corps understrength, had forced the people to hire mercenaries at their own expense; pay and transport costs ran to several times normal taxes. Petitioners protested that conscription alone had drained the countryside and village corps could no longer be raised.

sentences.zh: 其開封等府百姓聞歸、陳雇勇之苦，亦復觀望，不肯實辦。

translations.literal: The people of Kaifeng and other prefectures, hearing of the suffering from hired braves in Gui and Chen, likewise held back in observation and refused to carry it out in earnest.
translations.idiomatic: When the people of Kaifeng and neighboring prefectures heard how Gui and Chen had suffered under hired mercenaries, they too held back and refused to commit in earnest.

sentences.zh: 團練之事，仍恐有名無實。

translations.literal: As for militia training affairs, there was still fear of having a name without substance.
translations.idiomatic: The tuanlian program still risked being all form and no substance.

sentences.zh: 尋奉諭：「用民之法，總宜深得民心。

translations.literal: Soon an edict was received: "Methods of using the people should in all cases deeply win the people's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict soon arrived: "Any policy that relies on the people must first win their hearts.

sentences.zh: 勝保等所辦章程既與民心不洽，自應改弦更張，以期得力。

translations.literal: Since the regulations handled by Sheng Bao and others were already incompatible with the people's hearts, they should naturally change the strings and retune the bow, in hope of obtaining effectiveness.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao's regulations have alienated the public and must be thoroughly revised if they are to work.

sentences.zh: 慶廉即體察情形，將此項雇勇酌量裁撤。

translations.literal: Qing Lian should immediately observe and assess conditions and appropriately reduce and disband this category of hired braves.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Lian was to assess local conditions and scale back the hired mercenaries accordingly.

sentences.zh: 毛昶熙按照載垣等會議章程，速即集團練勇，以輔兵力。

translations.literal: Mao Changxi, according to the council regulations of Zaiyuan and others, should swiftly assemble militia training braves to supplement military strength.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Changxi was to follow the regulations agreed by Zaiyuan and his colleagues, muster tuanlian forces at once, and support the regular army.

sentences.zh: 」又以甘肅控制西陲，地方遼闊，且與陝西、四川毗連，匪患未靖，自應一律舉辦團練，以靖邊陲。

translations.literal: " It was further noted that Gansu controls the western frontier; the territory is vast, and it adjoins Shaanxi and Sichuan; bandit troubles are not yet pacified—it should naturally uniformly undertake militia training to pacify the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: " Gansu, moreover, held the western marches: a vast territory adjoining Shaanxi and Sichuan where unrest was not yet subdued. Tuanlian should be organized there as well to secure the frontier.

sentences.zh: 所有甘肅省團練事宜，即命陝甘總督樂斌督辦，並命甘涼道蕭浚蘭、刑部員外郎吳可讀、江西候補道楊升幫辦團練。

translations.literal: All Gansu Province militia training affairs were at once ordered to be supervised by Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Yue Bin, and Ganliang Circuit Intendant Xiao Junlan, Ministry of Justice Second Secretary Wu Kedu, and Jiangxi Expectant Circuit Intendant Yang Sheng were ordered to assist in handling militia training.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu tuanlian was assigned to Governor-General Yue Bin, assisted by Circuit Intendant Xiao Junlan, Ministry of Justice secretary Wu Kedu, and expectant Jiangxi intendant Yang Sheng.

sentences.zh: 十一年，以歸化之番眾僧俗兵四千餘人，馬四千餘匹，防禦抱罕羌人。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, more than four thousand monk and lay troops of the Guihua tribespeople, and more than four thousand horses, were used to defend against the Baohan Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, over four thousand Guihua tribal monks and laymen, with as many horses, were deployed against the Baohan Qiang.

sentences.zh: 是年，奉諭：「鄉團之設，原以濟兵力所不逮。

translations.literal: That year, an edict was received: "The establishment of village corps was originally to make up where military strength could not reach.
translations.idiomatic: That same year came an edict: "Village corps were created to fill gaps the regular army could not cover.

sentences.zh: 必須官紳一體，兵勇同心協力，內靖土匪，外御賊氛，於地方庶有裨益。

translations.literal: Officials and gentry must act as one body; soldiers and braves must join hearts and cooperate in strength—pacifying internal bandits and repelling external rebel atmospheres—then the locality may have benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and gentry must act together with soldiers and braves, pacify local bandits, hold off rebel incursions, and only then will the district gain real benefit.

sentences.zh: 若如清盛疏劾山東章丘縣之水賽街、新城之南婁里等庄，以及博山、萊蕪等縣鄉團，遇有經過客商，往來差役，輒敢擅行殺戮，害及無辜。

translations.literal: If like Qing Sheng's memorial impeaching Shandong's Zhangqiu County at Shuisai Street, Xincheng's Nanlouli and other villages, and village corps in Boshan, Laiwu, and other counties—when traveling merchants or passing runners met them, they dared to kill on their own authority, harming the innocent.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Qing Sheng reported that in Zhangqiu's Shuisai Street, Xincheng's Nanlouli, and in Boshan and Laiwu, local corps killed passing merchants and government runners on their own authority, innocent victims included.

sentences.zh: 撫署之差弁馬匹，亦被劫奪。

translations.literal: Runners and horses of the governor's office were also robbed and seized.
translations.idiomatic: Even couriers and horses from the provincial governor's yamen had been seized.

sentences.zh: 是團練御賊尚無成效，而抗官滋事竟有滋蔓之勢。

translations.literal: Thus militia training in repelling bandits still had no results, while defying officials and stirring trouble actually showed a trend of spreading.
translations.idiomatic: The corps had failed against bandits while defying officials and breeding unrest.

sentences.zh: 巡撫譚廷襄速將清盛所奏各情，嚴密查訪。

translations.literal: Governor Tan Tingxiang should swiftly take all matters Qing Sheng reported and investigate them strictly.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Tan Tingxiang was ordered to investigate every detail in Qing Sheng's report without delay.

sentences.zh: 如有藉團為名，肆行不法，及私立黑團，聚眾抗官，立即嚴懲。

translations.literal: If any used the corps as a pretext to act lawlessly at will, or privately established black corps, gathered crowds to defy officials—immediately punish severely.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who used the corps as cover for lawlessness, ran unauthorized "black" corps, or gathered mobs to defy officials was to be punished at once.

sentences.zh: 」又諭浙江巡撫：「前以浙省軍務未平，籌辦團練，勸諭捐輸，原以保衛民生。

translations.literal: " The Zhejiang governor was further instructed: "Previously, because Zhejiang's military affairs were not yet pacified, militia training was planned and donation drives were urged—originally to protect the people's livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: " The Zhejiang governor was told separately: "With the province still at war, tuanlian and donation drives were urged to protect the people.

sentences.zh: 若如王履謙疏劾辦團情形，雜亂無章，勸捐委員，令捐戶加捐至數十倍之多，並於捐戶加以威逼。

translations.literal: If like the situation Wang Lvqian impeached in memorial on handling corps—chaotic without order, donation commissioners ordering donors to increase donations by as much as several tens of times, and moreover applying coercion to donors.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lvqian reported chaotic management: commissioners demanding donations ten times the assessed amount and threatening donors who resisted.

sentences.zh: 今賊氛逼近浙東，若因勸捐辦理不善，致失人心，必致激成內訌。

translations.literal: Now the rebel atmosphere presses close to eastern Zhejiang; if because donation urging is poorly handled it causes loss of the people's hearts, it will surely provoke internal strife.
translations.idiomatic: With rebels nearing eastern Zhejiang, bungled fundraising would alienate the people and invite internal revolt.

sentences.zh: 巡撫王有齡速即會同王履謙妥為勸辦，議定章程，不得徇私委派貪劣之員。

translations.literal: Governor Wang Youling should swiftly join with Wang Lvqian to handle urging properly, agree on regulations, and must not show favoritism in appointing greedy and inferior men.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Wang Youling was to work with Wang Lvqian, set fair regulations, and appoint no corrupt or incompetent agents.

sentences.zh: 是年，左副都御史潘祖廕疏言：「各省設立團練大臣，辦理年餘，曾無一效，請獎請敘，紛紛效尤，並未克復一城，其為無益，已可概見。

translations.literal: That year, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief Pan Zuyin memorialized: "Each province established Grand Ministers for Militia Training; after more than a year of handling, there was never a single effect, yet requests for rewards and promotions were made repeatedly in imitation, and not a single city was recovered—their uselessness can already be seen in general.
translations.idiomatic: That year Left Vice Censor Pan Zuyin wrote: "Provincial tuanlian grand ministers have worked for over a year without a single success, yet officials clamor for rewards and promotions though not one city has been recovered—their futility is obvious.

sentences.zh: 應將團練大臣分別裁撤，以一事機而節糜費。

translations.literal: The Grand Ministers for Militia Training should be separately abolished, to unify affairs and economize on wasteful spending.
translations.idiomatic: Those grand ministers should be abolished province by province to unify command and cut waste.

sentences.zh: 」翰林院侍講學士顏宗儀疏言：「鄉團之設，原以百姓之財力，衛百姓之身家，果能眾志成城，同仇敵愾，即一舉、貢、生、監，足以統領之，無俟大員為之督率。

translations.literal: " Hanlin Academy Serving Expositor Yan Zongyi memorialized: "The establishment of village corps was originally to use the common people's financial strength to guard the common people's persons and households. If truly united will can make a city wall, and shared hatred of the enemy can arise—then even one licentiate, tribute student, Literatus, or student in the Imperial Academy is sufficient to lead them; there is no need for high officers to supervise and drive them.
translations.idiomatic: " Expositor Yan Zongyi argued: "Village corps exist so the people may defend themselves with their own means. Where communities unite in common purpose, a licentiate or scholar is leadership enough—no senior official need supervise them.

sentences.zh: 若必以大僚綜任之，幫辦司員分理之，是督撫之外又設督撫，僚屬之外又增僚屬，徒滋紛擾。

translations.literal: If high commissioners must comprehensively hold the post and assisting office staff divide management—this is setting up governors-general outside governors-general, adding subordinates outside subordinates, merely breeding confusion.
translations.idiomatic: If mandarins must supervise while staff deputies divide the work, one creates governors atop governors and clerks atop clerks—nothing but confusion.

sentences.zh: 上年豫省辦團，各省團練大臣亦紛紛四齣。

translations.literal: Last year when Henan Province undertook corps, Grand Ministers for Militia Training in every province also scattered in all directions.
translations.idiomatic: When Henan organized corps the year before, tuanlian grand ministers fanned out across every province.

sentences.zh: 旋因浙江、四川、陝西、甘肅等省情形不同，旋即裁撤。

translations.literal: Soon because Zhejiang, Sichuan, Shaanxi, Gansu, and other provinces had differing conditions, they were soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang, Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Gansu soon abolished the posts because local conditions differed.

sentences.zh: 而直隸、山東、江南、江北等處，則仍歸由團練大臣辦理。

translations.literal: Yet in Zhili, Shandong, Jiangnan, Jiangbei, and other places, affairs still returned to handling by Grand Ministers for Militia Training.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili, Shandong, Jiangnan, and Jiangbei, however, still left affairs to the grand ministers.

sentences.zh: 於是幫辦人員假公濟私，百端紛擾。

translations.literal: Thereupon assisting personnel used public office for private gain; a hundred kinds of troubles arose.
translations.idiomatic: Their deputies then used public office for private gain in countless ways.

sentences.zh: 或偪勒州縣供應，或苛派民間銀錢，或於官設捐局之外，團練再設捐局，或於官抽釐金之外，團練再抽釐金，或查閱各處團防，支應紛煩，地方告乏，或任令家人奴僕勒索規費，約束不嚴。

translations.literal: Some compelled prefectures and counties to supply them; some exacted silver from the people; some beyond official donation bureaus set up corps donation bureaus; some beyond official likin levies corps extracted likin again; some inspecting local corps defenses imposed vexing support, localities reporting exhaustion; some let family members and servants extort regulation fees, discipline not strict.
translations.idiomatic: Some forced prefectures and counties to feed them; some extorted silver from the people; some ran donation offices alongside official ones; some levied likin on top of government collections; some touring "inspections" exhausted districts with demands for hospitality; some let servants extort fees with no discipline.

sentences.zh: 幫辦人員或十餘人，或數十人，薪水所出，皆刻剝民間。

translations.literal: Assisting personnel might be more than ten persons or several tens; salaries came from all being carved and stripped from among the people.
translations.idiomatic: A single post might employ ten or thirty deputies, every salary gouged from the people.

sentences.zh: 刁生劣監，因以把持地方；

translations.literal: Crafty students and inferior licentiates thereby seized control of localities;
translations.idiomatic: Shady scholars and degree-holders thus dominated local affairs;

sentences.zh: 狡吏貪夫，藉以希圖名利，流弊實多。

translations.literal: Cunning clerks and greedy men borrowed it to scheme for fame and profit—the flowing abuses were truly many.
translations.idiomatic: Cunning clerks and greedy men pursued profit and reputation by the same means, with abuses too many to list.

sentences.zh: 各省團練大臣，直隸桑春榮操守尚嚴，山東杜已嘖有煩言，至於江北、江南所辦鄉團，自上年至今，未聞有團練大臣收復一州一縣者，徒以騷動天下，無益有損。

translations.literal: Grand Ministers for Militia Training in each province: in Zhili Sang Chunrong's integrity was still strict; in Shandong Du Yi already had vexing talk; as for village corps handled in Jiangbei and Jiangnan, from last year until now, there has been no hearing of a Grand Minister for Militia Training recovering a single prefecture or county—they merely stirred up the world under heaven, useless with harm.
translations.idiomatic: Among the grand ministers, Zhili's Sang Chunrong remained relatively scrupulous, Shandong's Du Yi was already notorious, and in Jiangbei and Jiangnan not one prefecture or county had been recovered—only nationwide turmoil, harm without benefit.

sentences.zh: 今山東杜已經撤回，河南毛昶熙較有成效，其直隸、江南、江北等處團練大臣，宜一併撤回。

translations.literal: Now Shandong's Du Yi has already been recalled; Henan's Mao Changxi has comparatively had results—the Grand Ministers for Militia Training in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangbei, and other places should all be withdrawn together.
translations.idiomatic: Du Yi had already been recalled from Shandong and Mao Changxi had done better in Henan; the Zhili, Jiangnan, and Jiangbei grand ministers should all be withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 其各省州縣距賊較遠者，停止辦團，以安民業。

translations.literal: In each province, prefectures and counties farther from rebels should cease organizing corps, to settle the people's occupations.
translations.idiomatic: Counties far from the fighting should stop organizing corps and let people return to their livelihoods.

sentences.zh: 其距賊較近之處，仍責地方官切實辦團，而以本省督撫總其成，庶事權不至紛歧，商民可免滋擾。

translations.literal: Where distance to rebels is nearer, local officials should still be charged to organize corps in earnest, with the province's governor-general and governor overseeing completion—then perhaps administrative authority will not become divided, and merchants and commoners can avoid spreading harassment.
translations.idiomatic: Near the front, local officials should still run corps under provincial governors so authority stays unified and merchants are spared further harassment.

sentences.zh: 旋奉諭：「直隸團練大臣桑春榮回京供職，直隸團練事宜，責成文煜辦理。

translations.literal: Soon an edict was received: "Zhili's Grand Minister for Militia Training Sang Chunrong returns to the capital to resume office; Zhili militia training affairs are charged to Wen Yu to handle.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed: "Zhili's tuanlian grand minister Sang Chunrong was recalled to the capital; Wen Yu would take charge of Zhili tuanlian.

sentences.zh: 江西團練大臣劉繹來京任用，江西團練事宜，責成毓科督同官紳辦理。

translations.literal: Jiangxi's Grand Minister for Militia Training Liu Yi comes to the capital for appointment; Jiangxi militia training affairs are charged to Yu Ke to supervise together with officials and gentry in handling.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi's grand minister Liu Yi was summoned to the capital; Yu Ke would supervise tuanlian there with local officials and gentry.

sentences.zh: 其二省京官如有回籍辦團者，各部院查取職名，飭令來京供職。

translations.literal: If in these two provinces capital officials had returned to their native places to handle corps, each ministry and court should look up their titles and order them to come to the capital to resume office.
translations.idiomatic: Any capital officials from those provinces who had gone home to run corps were to be identified by their ministries and ordered back to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 江北團練大臣晏端書，江西團練大臣龐鍾璐，其辦理團練，是否仍須該員經理，抑或即可裁撤，令曾國籓、薛煥速議以聞。

translations.literal: Jiangbei's Grand Minister for Militia Training Yan Duanshu and Jiangxi's Grand Minister for Militia Training Pang Zhonglu—whether their handling of militia training still requires these men to manage it, or they can immediately be abolished—order Zeng Guofan and Xue Huan to deliberate swiftly and report.
translations.idiomatic: Whether Jiangbei's Yan Duanshu and Jiangxi's Pang Zhonglu were still needed or could be abolished at once was referred to Zeng Guofan and Xue Huan for prompt recommendation.

sentences.zh: 王履謙幫辦浙江團練，兼辦浙東捐務，今浙江軍務方殷，自難遽撤。

translations.literal: Wang Lvqian assists in handling Zhejiang militia training and concurrently handles eastern Zhejiang donation affairs; now Zhejiang's military affairs are still pressing, so he naturally cannot be abruptly withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lvqian, who assisted Zhejiang tuanlian and ran eastern Zhejiang donations, could not be removed while the province remained at war.

sentences.zh: 令王有齡會同王履謙切實籌辦，以固疆圉。

translations.literal: Order Wang Youling to join with Wang Lvqian in earnest planning and handling, to secure the frontier defenses.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Youling was to work with him in earnest to strengthen the frontier.

sentences.zh: 毛昶熙在河南歸德著有成效，應否仍令毛昶熙督辦團練，及有無把握之處，令嚴樹森速議以聞。

translations.literal: Mao Changxi at Henan's Guide had marked results—whether he should still be ordered to supervise militia training, and where there is or is not assurance—order Yan Shusen to deliberate swiftly and report.
translations.idiomatic: Whether Mao Changxi, who had done well at Guide in Henan, should continue to supervise tuanlian, and where the policy was viable, was referred to Yan Shusen for prompt report.

sentences.zh: 旋兩江總督曾國籓覆陳：「團練之設，只能防小支千餘之游匪，不能剿大股數萬之悍賊。

translations.literal: Soon Liangjiang Governor-General Zeng Guofan replied: "The establishment of militia training can only defend against small bands of a thousand-odd roaming bandits; it cannot suppress large columns of tens of thousands of fierce rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Zeng Guofan of Liangjiang soon replied: "Tuanlian can hold off roaming bands of a thousand men at most; they cannot destroy rebel columns tens of thousands strong.

sentences.zh: 其練丁口糧，若太多，則與募勇之價相等，不必僅以團名；

translations.literal: Their drill members' grain rations—if too much, they equal the price of recruited braves, and there is no need to use only the corps name;
translations.idiomatic: If drill stipends are too high, they match mercenary pay and the corps label adds nothing;

sentences.zh: 若太少，則與官勇之餉迥殊，不能得其死力。

translations.literal: if too little, they differ greatly from government braves' pay and one cannot obtain their utmost effort unto death.
translations.idiomatic: if too low, they fall far below regular army pay and men will not fight to the death.

sentences.zh: 其團防經費，若取諸丁、漕、釐、捐四者之中，則有礙督撫籌款之途；

translations.literal: Their corps defense funds—if drawn from among the four of poll tax, grain transport, likin, and donations—then they obstruct the governors' paths for raising funds;
translations.idiomatic: If corps defense funds come from poll tax, grain transport, likin, or donations, they compete with provincial revenue;

sentences.zh: 若設法四者之外，則更無措手之處。

translations.literal: If one seeks funds beyond those four sources, there is even less room to act.
translations.idiomatic: If funding is sought outside those four channels, there is nowhere else to turn.

sentences.zh: 事權既無專屬，剛柔實覺兩難。

translations.literal: Since authority has no sole holder, hardness and softness in truth feel doubly difficult.
translations.idiomatic: With no single authority in charge, it is genuinely hard to strike the right balance between firmness and leniency.

sentences.zh: 晏端書在江北不設餉局，但勸各邑築圩自保，龐鍾璐在江南激勸鄉民，俾知同仇敵愾之義，辦理極有斟酌。

translations.literal: Yan Duanshu in Jiangbei did not set up ration bureaus, but urged each district to build dikes for self-defense; Pang Zhonglu in Jiangnan vigorously urged the township people, causing them to know the principle of shared enmity and hatred of the foe—handling the matter with great discretion.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiangbei, Yan Duanshu declined to establish supply bureaus and instead urged each county to build fortified embankments for self-defense; in Jiangnan, Pang Zhonglu roused the villagers to a common hatred of the enemy. Both managed affairs with notable judgment.

sentences.zh: 今之賊勢，決非鄉團所能奏功。

translations.literal: Today's bandit strength is absolutely not something village corps can achieve success against.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels' power today is far beyond what village militia alone can overcome.

sentences.zh: 應俟賊氛稍衰，大功將成，然後辦團練以善其後。

translations.literal: One should wait until the bandit atmosphere slightly declines and the great achievement is nearly done, then only organize militia training to put the aftermath in good order.
translations.idiomatic: Militia training should wait until the insurgency weakens and the main campaign nears completion, then be organized to secure the aftermath.

sentences.zh: 晏端書、龐鍾璐二員，清操雅望，內任最宜。

translations.literal: The two officers Yan Duanshu and Pang Zhonglu have pure conduct and elegant reputation; posts within the capital are most fitting for them.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Duanshu and Pang Zhonglu are men of integrity and high standing, best suited for appointments at court.

sentences.zh: 應請裁去團練差使，回京供職。

translations.literal: It should be requested to cut away their militia-training special assignments and return to the capital to serve in office.
translations.idiomatic: Their special militia assignments should be abolished and they recalled to Beijing to resume regular duties.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，允之。

translations.literal: " The memorial entered; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was submitted and approved.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，諭：「鄉團之設，原以使民自衛身家，藉可保全地方，以輔官兵。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, an edict said: "The establishment of village corps was originally to enable the people to defend their own persons and property, thereby preserving local areas and assisting the regular troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi (1862), an edict declared: "Village militia were originally meant to let people defend their lives and property, preserve the locality, and support the regular army.

sentences.zh: 前因各路辦理團練大臣隨帶多員，任意騷擾，有害無利，是以陸續裁撤，仍責令地方官切實經理。

translations.literal: Previously because militia-training commissioners on the various routes brought along many subordinates and arbitrarily harassed people—harm without benefit—they were successively abolished, and local officials were still charged to manage matters conscientiously.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, commissioners for militia training across the provinces had brought large staffs who harassed the populace at will, doing more harm than good; they were therefore phased out, and local officials were again ordered to manage militia affairs conscientiously.

sentences.zh: 乃邇來統兵大員，守土牧令，或恐其分餉而輕為裁撤，或疑其無益而視為具文，於是民心不固，盜賊橫行，所過州縣村莊，動遭劫掠，是又地方官不能因地制宜舉行團練之所致，因噎廢食，貽誤殊多。

translations.literal: Yet recently commanders-in-chief and territorial magistrates, some fearing militia would divide rations and rashly abolished them, some doubting their use and treating them as empty documents—whereupon popular hearts were not firm, bandits and robbers ran rampant, and wherever they passed, prefectures, counties, villages, and hamlets were constantly plundered; this again was caused by local officials' inability to organize militia training according to local conditions—abandoning food for fear of choking, with very great loss and error.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, however, supreme commanders and local magistrates had either abolished militia rashly for fear they would divert military pay, or dismissed them as mere paperwork as useless—and popular morale collapsed, bandits ran wild, and county after county fell to looting. This was itself the fault of local officials who failed to adapt militia organization to local conditions: throwing out the baby with the bathwater, at grievous cost.

sentences.zh: 嗣後各省團練，仍由督撫臣通飭各州縣，選公正紳士，實力興辦。

translations.literal: Hereafter in each province militia training shall still be ordered throughout by the governor-general or governor, with each prefecture and county selecting upright gentry and vigorously establishing it.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth each province's militia shall again be directed by the governor-general or governor, who shall instruct every prefecture and county to choose upright gentry and establish militia in earnest.

sentences.zh: 務使官不掣肘，民悉同心，城市鄉村，聲勢聯絡。

translations.literal: It is essential that officials not check and hold back, that the people be wholly of one mind, and that cities, towns, villages, and countryside link their strength and momentum.
translations.idiomatic: Officials must not hobble the effort; the people must stand united; cities and countryside must be linked in mutual support.

sentences.zh: 其有認真辦理保全地方者，將其實在勞績，聲明保獎。

translations.literal: For those who truly manage affairs and preserve local areas, their actual labor and achievements shall be reported for reward and commendation.
translations.idiomatic: Those who earnestly organize militia and secure their districts shall have their real achievements reported for official reward.

sentences.zh: 二年，以都察院代遞山東貢生硃德秀條陳團練事宜，語多可采，命硃德秀回籍，隨同英桂、趙德轍辦理團練，並命英桂督飭官紳，就地方情形，認真辦團，毋得有名無實。

translations.literal: In the second year, the Censorate forwarded on behalf the Shandong tribute student Zhu Dexiu's detailed proposals on militia training matters; much of the language was adoptable. Zhu Dexiu was ordered to return to his native place, to assist Ying Gui and Zhao Dezhe in managing militia training, and Ying Gui was also ordered to supervise officials and gentry, according to local conditions earnestly to organize corps, and not to have name without reality.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year (1863), the Censorate transmitted a memorial from Zhu Dexiu, a Shandong tribute student, on militia organization; many of his points were sound. Zhu was ordered home to assist Ying Gui and Zhao Dezhe in organizing militia, and Ying Gui was charged to oversee officials and gentry in earnest, locally appropriate militia work—not empty forms.

sentences.zh: 是年，統兵大臣僧格林沁疏言：「各省練團築寨，本以助守望而禦寇盜，為權宜補救之法。

translations.literal: That year, the commander-in-chief Sengge Rinchen memorialized: "In the various provinces trained corps building stockades were originally to assist watch and defense and repel bandits and robbers, as an expedient remedial method.
translations.idiomatic: That year Commander Sengge Rinchen memorialized: "Fortified militia camps in the provinces were originally a stopgap to aid watch and defense against bandits,

sentences.zh: 乃各團每以有寨可據，輒藐視官長，擅理詞訟，或聚眾抗糧，或挾仇械鬥，甚至謀為不軌，踞城戕官，如山東之劉德培，河南之李瞻，先後倡亂，而安徽之苗沛霖，尤為梟桀反覆，勞師糜餉，始得次第翦除。

translations.literal: Yet each corps, because it had a stockade to rely on, would often despise official superiors, judge lawsuits on its own, gather crowds to resist grain tax, or take vendettas into armed fights; some even plotted treason, seized cities and killed officials—as in Shandong's Liu Depei and Henan's Li Zhan, who successively led disturbances, while Anhui's Miao Peilin was especially a fierce, fickle figure; only after exhausting troops and provisions was he eliminated step by step.
translations.idiomatic: yet militia with walled camps often defied magistrates, adjudicated disputes on their own, resisted tax collection by force, or fought feuds with arms—some even plotted rebellion and seized cities, killing officials. Liu Depei of Shandong and Li Zhan of Henan had led such uprisings in turn; Miao Peilin of Anhui was the worst—a ruthless turncoat eliminated only after vast expenditure of troops and supplies.

sentences.zh: 辦團之舉，始則合一鄉為一團，繼則聯眾團為一練，地廣人多，良莠不齊，不肖團長有跋扈情形，承辦團練紳士又不能杜漸防微，隨時舉發，致有尾大不掉之勢。

translations.literal: The undertaking of organizing corps began with uniting one township as one corps, then linking many corps into one drill unit; the territory was broad and the people many, good and bad not uniform; unworthy corps heads had overbearing conduct, while gentry in charge of militia training could not stop evil at the first sign and prevent its spread or report it in timely fashion, leading to a situation where the tail grows too large to wag.
translations.idiomatic: Organizing militia began with one corps per township, then linked corps into larger drill units across wide territories and large populations, mixing good men with bad. Unworthy corps leaders grew overbearing; responsible gentry failed to check abuses early and report them, until the movement grew too powerful to control.

sentences.zh: 況捻匪屢經竄擾之區，亦未見各團堵御得力。

translations.literal: Moreover, in regions repeatedly raided by Nian bandits, one also did not see the various corps block and defend with effect.
translations.idiomatic: Even in regions repeatedly raided by Nian bandits, the corps had rarely mounted an effective defense.

sentences.zh: 其河南團練，均由侍郎毛昶熙管理。

translations.literal: The Henan militia training was entirely managed by Vice Minister Mao Changxi.
translations.idiomatic: Henan militia were entirely overseen by Vice Minister Mao Changxi.

sentences.zh: 毛昶熙於通省地方，勢難周曆兼顧，而各練既有專管大員，地方官轉至呼應不靈。

translations.literal: Mao Changxi, regarding the whole province's territory, found it hard in power to tour everywhere and attend to all; yet with each drill unit already having a dedicated supervising grandee, local officials in turn found response and coordination inflexible.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Changxi could hardly tour the entire province, and with dedicated overseers for each drill unit, local officials lost the ability to coordinate effectively.

sentences.zh: 今賊氛漸平，請命毛昶熙回京供職，所有團練，視直隸、山東之例，歸地方官經理，以一事權。

translations.literal: Now that the bandit atmosphere is gradually pacified, it is requested to order Mao Changxi to return to the capital to serve in office; all militia training, following the precedents of Zhili and Shandong, shall revert to management by local officials, to unify authority.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the rebellion is subsiding, Mao Changxi should be recalled to Beijing; all militia should follow the Zhili and Shandong precedent and be placed under local officials, unifying authority.

sentences.zh: 並請飭河南巡撫嚴查各團，如有增置軍械等事，均責令稟請地方官允准置備。

translations.literal: It is also requested to order the Henan governor strictly to inspect each corps; if there are matters such as adding military equipment, all shall be charged to report and request the local official's approval before provision.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan governor should also be ordered to inspect every corps strictly: any addition of arms must be reported to and approved by the local magistrate before procurement.

sentences.zh: 如不肖團長借修圍制械，種種斂錢，以致苦累鄉民，即從嚴懲辦，庶幾權歸於上，免滋流弊。

translations.literal: If unworthy corps heads, under pretext of repairing stockades and making weapons, levy money in every way and thereby burden the township people, they shall be sternly punished, so that authority may return above and flowing abuses be avoided.
translations.idiomatic: Unworthy corps leaders who levy money under pretext of fortifications and armaments, oppressing the villages, must be punished severely so authority rests with the state and abuses do not spread.

sentences.zh: 」御史裘德俊疏言：「團練之舉，本屬有治人無治法。

translations.literal: " The investigating censor Qiu Dejun memorialized: "The undertaking of militia training fundamentally belongs to the category of having men to govern but no method of governance.
translations.idiomatic: " Censor Qiu Dejun memorialized: "Militia training is fundamentally a matter of having the right men to govern, not laws to govern.

sentences.zh: 今直隸善後章程，有抽撥鄉團訓練之議。

translations.literal: Now the Zhili post-pacification regulations contain a proposal to draft and transfer village corps for training.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhili postwar regulations now propose drafting village militia for training.

sentences.zh: 但抽撥鄉兵，必得賢明牧令，駕馭有方，乃能權不下移，民無擾累。

translations.literal: But in drafting and transferring township soldiers, one must have wise and enlightened territorial magistrates who drive and rein with method, only then can authority not shift downward and the people be free of harassing burdens.
translations.idiomatic: But drafting township militia requires wise magistrates skilled in control, so power does not devolve downward and the people are not harassed.

sentences.zh: 若遇不肖州縣，借端苛斂，抽丁派費，吏胥因緣為奸，上下咸思中飽，小民已不聊生；

translations.literal: If one meets unworthy prefectures and counties that seize pretexts for harsh levies, draft men and assign fees, clerks and runners seize opportunity for villainy, above and below all thinking to fill their own purses—the common people already cannot support life;
translations.idiomatic: Under corrupt prefectural and county officials, pretexts become harsh levies, conscription brings fees, clerks profit from the chaos, and everyone from top to bottom grabs a cut—the common people can barely survive;

sentences.zh: 加以每縣聚眾數百人，游手無著，以強凌弱，甚或恃眾把持，一有亂萌，尤易響應，不可不遠慮及之。

translations.literal: Added to this, in each county hundreds gather in crowds, idlers without fixed occupation, the strong bullying the weak, some even relying on the multitude to dominate; once there is a sprout of disorder, they are especially easy to answer in echo—this cannot but be foreseen from afar.
translations.idiomatic: and each county assembles hundreds of idle men who bully the weak, some dominating by sheer numbers—at the first sign of unrest they will readily join in. This must be foreseen.

sentences.zh: 旋奉諭：「山東鄉團已由官為經理，所有河南省團練事宜，亦統歸官辦，以一事權。

translations.literal: Shortly an edict was received: "Shandong village corps are already managed by officials; all Henan Province militia-training matters shall also uniformly revert to official handling, to unify authority.
translations.idiomatic: An edict soon followed: "Shandong village militia are already under official management; all Henan militia affairs shall likewise be handled by officials, unifying authority.

sentences.zh: 其直隸抽練團丁，督臣劉長佑權其利害，是否可行，如有窒礙之處，即據實以聞。

translations.literal: As for Zhili's drafting of militia trainees for drill, the governor Liu Changyou shall weigh its benefits and harms, whether it can be carried out; if there are obstructing points, he shall report the facts at once.
translations.idiomatic: As for Zhili's plan to draft militia trainees for drill, Governor Liu Changyou shall weigh the pros and cons and report frankly whether it is feasible or encounters obstacles.

sentences.zh: 六年，李雲麟招募奇古民勇駐八里岡，與科布多、塔爾巴哈台蒙兵為犄角。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Li Yunlin recruited Qigu civilian braves and stationed them at Baligang, forming a pincer support with Mongol troops of Kobdo and Tarbagatai.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (1867), Li Yunlin recruited Qigu civilian braves and garrisoned them at Baligang in mutual support with Mongol troops from Kobdo and Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 七年，諭各疆臣：「捻寇蕩平，勇丁亦各還鄉里，誠恐江南、安徽、河南、山東從前被兵處所，不免伏莽潛匿，乘隙為害。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the various frontier officials were admonished: "The Nian bandits have been swept away; brave soldiers too have each returned to their townships and villages. We truly fear that in Jiangnan, Anhui, Henan, and Shandong—places formerly afflicted by warfare—hidden brambles may lurk and seize openings to do harm.
