translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1868), frontier officials were instructed: "The Nian rebels have been suppressed and the braves have returned home, yet we fear that in war-scarred Jiangnan, Anhui, Henan, and Shandong, hidden malcontents may still lurk and strike when opportunity allows.

sentences.zh: 江、皖等省督撫，於徐、海、潁、亳、歸、汝、曹、沂等處，飭各地方官勸諭民間照舊修理圩寨，整頓鄉團，互相保衛。

translations.literal: The governors-general and governors of Jiangsu, Anhui, and other provinces, in places such as Xu, Hai, Ying, Bo, Gui, Ru, Cao, and Yi, shall order each local official to urge and instruct the populace to repair dikes and stockades as before, put village corps in order, and guard one another.
translations.idiomatic: Governors of Jiangsu, Anhui, and related provinces shall order local officials in the Xu, Hai, Ying, Bo, Gui, Ru, Cao, and Yi regions to urge the people to repair fortified embankments as before, reorganize village militia, and provide mutual defense.

sentences.zh: 此外各處民團，亦應一律整飭，慎選牧令，安良除暴，以靖地方。

translations.literal: Besides this, civilian corps everywhere should also uniformly be put in order, territorial magistrates carefully chosen, the good settled and violence removed, to pacify local areas.
translations.idiomatic: Civilian militia elsewhere should likewise be reorganized, magistrates chosen with care, the law-abiding protected and the violent suppressed, to secure the peace.

sentences.zh: 十二年，因四川峨邊廳蠻族投誠，擇充千百戶等職，編製夷兵，建修碉堡。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, because the barbarian tribes of Ebian Subprefecture in Sichuan submitted in allegiance, they were selected and installed in posts such as chiliarch and centurion, Yi troops were organized and registered, and blockhouses were built and repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year (1873), after the tribal peoples of Ebian Subprefecture in Sichuan submitted, selected leaders were appointed chiliarchs and centurions, Yi troops were organized, and blockhouses built and repaired.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年，兩廣總督張之洞募沙民千人助守虎門，楊玉科增募千人及惠清營五百人，鄭紹忠募安勇二千人，所募鄉兵，以防勇規制編之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu, the Governor-General of the Two Guangs Zhang Zhidong recruited a thousand sand-dwellers to assist in defending Humen; Yang Yuke additionally recruited a thousand men and five hundred for the Huiqing battalion; Zheng Shaozhong recruited two thousand An braves; the township soldiers recruited were organized according to the regulations for defense braves.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Guangxu (1880), Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of the Two Guangs recruited a thousand sand-dwellers to help garrison Humen; Yang Yuke added a thousand men plus five hundred for the Huiqing battalion; Zheng Shaozhong raised two thousand An braves—all enrolled as township militia under the defense-brave regulations.

sentences.zh: 是年，命黑龍江將軍於增練馬隊外，秋冬之季，招集打牲人等，加以訓練。

translations.literal: That year, the Heilongjiang general was ordered that, besides increasing drilled cavalry companies, in the autumn and winter seasons hunting peoples and the like should be gathered and given training.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Heilongjiang general was also ordered that, beyond expanding the cavalry companies, he should recruit hunting peoples in autumn and winter and put them through training.

sentences.zh: 八年，兩江總督左宗棠以江蘇沿江海州縣捕魚為業者甚多，於內江外海風濤沙線無不熟諳，而崇明尤為各海口漁戶爭趨之所。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the Governor-General of the Two Jiangs Zuo Zongtang noted that in Jiangsu's coastal prefectures and counties along the river and sea, those who take fishing as their livelihood are very numerous; of inner-river and outer-sea winds, waves, and sand lines none are not thoroughly familiar—and Chongming especially is where fishing households from every estuary vie to gather.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (1882), Governor-General Zuo Zongtang of the Two Jiangs observed that Jiangsu's coastal counties had vast numbers of fishermen thoroughly acquainted with inner rivers, open seas, winds, and shoals—and Chongming was the port where fishing fleets from every harbor converged.

sentences.zh: 其中有技勇而悉洋務者，所在不乏。

translations.literal: Among them are those with martial skill and courage who are thoroughly versed in foreign affairs—not lacking anywhere.
translations.idiomatic: Many among them were skilled fighters well versed in maritime affairs.

sentences.zh: 外洋船駛入內江者，每用漁戶為導。

translations.literal: When foreign-ocean ships sail into inner rivers, fishing households are regularly used as guides.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign vessels entering inland waters routinely relied on fishermen as pilots.

sentences.zh: 江蘇自川沙迄贛榆二十二州縣，濱臨江海，漁戶約數萬人。

translations.literal: In Jiangsu from Chuansha to Ganyu, twenty-two prefectures and counties border the river and sea; fishing households number roughly tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: From Chuansha to Ganyu, twenty-two Jiangsu prefectures and counties front the coast; fishermen numbered in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 乃令蘇松太道員為沿海漁團督辦，於漁戶每百人中，選壯健三十人，練漁團五千名，設總局於吳淞口，設分局於濱海各縣，每月操練二次，習水勇技藝，用以捕盜緝私，兼備水師之選。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Sutai circuit intendant was ordered to supervise the coastal fishing corps; from every hundred fishing households thirty sturdy men were selected, five thousand fishing corps trainees were drilled, a general bureau was set at Wusong mouth, branch bureaus in each coastal county, drill twice monthly, practicing water-brave skills—used to capture bandits and suppress smuggling, and also to supply selections for the navy.
translations.idiomatic: The Sutai circuit intendant was appointed to supervise coastal fishing militia: thirty sturdy men chosen from every hundred fishermen, five thousand trained in all, with a headquarters at Wusong and branch offices in coastal counties. They drilled twice monthly in naval skills to hunt pirates and suppress smuggling, and to serve as a pool for the fleet.

sentences.zh: 十一年，雲貴總督岑毓英釐定雲南通省營制，裸黑勇丁，編為六營，西南土防，編為二十五營。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, the Governor-General of Yunnan and Guizhou Cen Yuying fixed Yunnan's provincial garrison establishment: Luohei brave soldiers were organized into six battalions; southwestern native defense forces into twenty-five battalions.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1885), Governor-General Cen Yuying of Yunnan and Guizhou reorganized Yunnan's provincial forces: Luohei braves into six battalions and southwestern frontier defense troops into twenty-five.

sentences.zh: 又因雲南沿邊，由西而東南，皆野人山寨，布列於九隘之外，乃調兵二千人，與原有防軍及鄉團土司，協力警備。

translations.literal: Also because along Yunnan's borders, from west toward the southeast, all are wild people's mountain stockades arrayed beyond the nine passes, two thousand troops were transferred, to join with the original defense troops and village corps and native officials in cooperative alert defense.
translations.idiomatic: Because Yunnan's frontier from west to southeast was lined with tribal stockades beyond the nine passes, two thousand troops were deployed to work with existing garrisons, village militia, and native chiefs in joint patrol.

sentences.zh: 督辦廣東軍務大臣彭玉麟以欽州、廉州地廣兵單，招募鄉團協守。

translations.literal: The Grand Minister supervising Guangdong military affairs Peng Yulin, because Qinzhou and Lianzhou had broad territory but thin troops, recruited village corps to assist in defense.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Minister Peng Yulin, supervising Guangdong military affairs, recruited village militia to help garrison Qinzhou and Lianzhou, where territory was vast but regular troops few.

sentences.zh: 是年，吉林將軍增練防軍，佐以烏拉牲丁，凡萬五千人。

translations.literal: That year, the Jilin general increased training of defense troops, assisted by Wula hunting households, in all fifteen thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Jilin general expanded frontier defense forces, supplemented by fifteen thousand Wula hunting levies.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，都察院代陳湖南舉人何鎮圭條陳團練事宜，命兵部議奏。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, the Censorate transmitted on behalf of Hunan provincial graduate He Zhengui's detailed memorial on militia training affairs, and ordered the Ministry of War to deliberate and report.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year (1898), the Censorate forwarded Hunan graduate He Zhengui's proposals on tuanlian and referred them to the Ministry of War for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 又諭：「侍郎張廕桓疏請實行團練，同時臣工屢有仿西法練民兵之請。

translations.literal: It was further ordered: "Vice Minister Zhang Yinhuan memorialized requesting the earnest implementation of militia training; at the same time officials repeatedly requested training people's militia on the Western model."
translations.idiomatic: An edict added: "Vice Minister Zhang Yinhuan urged genuine tuanlian, while other officials repeatedly asked to drill a people's militia on Western lines."

sentences.zh: 若各省實行團練，即以鄉團為民兵，用更番替換之法，較諸遽練民兵為有把握。

translations.literal: If every province truly carried out militia training, then taking village corps as people's militia and using a method of rotation and replacement would be more reliable than hastily drilling a people's militia.
translations.idiomatic: If provinces really organized tuanlian and treated village corps as militia on a rotating roster, that would be surer than rushing into a new militia system.

sentences.zh: 廣西會匪滋事，尤宜速辦，以收捍禦之功。

translations.literal: Guangxi secret-society bandits were making trouble; this especially should be handled swiftly to reap the achievement of defense.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi secret-society outbreaks made speed especially urgent if the policy was to defend local communities.

sentences.zh: 各省督撫一律切實籌辦。

translations.literal: Governors-general and governors of every province were uniformly to plan and undertake this earnestly.
translations.idiomatic: Every provincial governor was to organize the program in earnest.

sentences.zh: 各省於三月內，廣東、廣西於一月內，將辦理情形，具疏以聞。

translations.literal: Every province within three months, Guangdong and Guangxi within one month, were to report the handling situation in memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces were to report progress within three months; Guangdong and Guangxi within one.

sentences.zh: 三十年，廣西巡撫柯逢時令廣西各州縣增募鄉勇八千人，給以毛瑟後膛槍，並令民間多築碉堡，共御外侮。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, Guangxi Governor Ke Fengshi ordered every prefecture and county in Guangxi to increase recruitment of village braves by eight thousand men, supplied with Mauser breech-loading rifles, and also ordered the populace to build many blockhouses to resist foreign aggression jointly.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year (1904), Guangxi governor Ke Fengshi raised eight thousand village braves across the province, armed them with Mauser rifles, and urged widespread blockhouse building against foreign encroachment.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，兩廣總督李經羲增練防營，並募土著鄉兵，備廣西邊境。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, Governor-General of the Two Guangs Li Jingyi increased training of defense battalions and also recruited native township militia to guard the Guangxi border.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year (1905), Li Jingyi of the Two Guangs expanded defense battalions and recruited native village militia for the Guangxi frontier.

sentences.zh: 新疆巡撫潘效蘇以新疆兵費太重，改募土著，仿勇營訓練，次第遣散客軍。

translations.literal: Xinjiang Governor Pan Xiaosu, because Xinjiang military expenses were too heavy, changed to recruiting natives, trained them on the model of brave battalions, and in turn dismissed guest armies.
translations.idiomatic: Xinjiang governor Pan Xiaosu, finding military costs unbearable, replaced outsider troops with locally recruited men trained like yongying and discharged the guest armies in stages.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，雲南防軍裁併，於騰越、臨安兩路創設團練，藉資捍衛。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, Yunnan defense troops were cut and merged; militia training was newly established on the Tengyue and Lin'an routes to lend strength for defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year (1908), Yunnan trimmed its defense army and created tuanlian on the Tengyue and Lin'an routes for local defense.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，各省改防營為巡防隊。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong, every province changed defense battalions into patrol-defense companies.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 (1909), provinces renamed defense battalions as patrol companies.

sentences.zh: 雲貴總督沈秉堃以雲南防軍內有各屬之保衛團，系昔日之鄉團，名為營隊，實即鄉兵，未能遽改為巡防隊，乃仍其舊。

translations.literal: Governor-General of Yunnan and Guizhou Shen Bingkun noted that within Yunnan defense troops were guard corps of various subordinates, which were formerly village corps—called battalion companies in name but in reality township militia—and could not hastily be changed into patrol-defense companies; the old arrangement was therefore retained.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-general Shen Bingkun reported that Yunnan's defense force still included old village guard units—battalions in name, militia in fact—and these could not be abruptly converted to patrol companies, so the former system remained.

sentences.zh: 此鄉兵舉廢之概略也。

translations.literal: This is the general outline of how local militia were established and abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Such, in outline, is the story of how local militia rose and fell.
